objective: Review the contextual patch-repair definition for the Verilator native option overlay patch after build-only validation exposed misplaced V3Options.h and V3Options.cpp hunks.

review_decision.weakest_point: The review accepts only a patch-shape repair boundary. It does not prove that the repaired patch builds, that parser behavior is correct, or that the native Verilator option flow works. The next implementation must avoid zero-context hunks and prove the repaired patch lands in the intended regions before any build-success or parser-support claim.
accepted_because: the run gate recorded an actual compile failure after reaching verilator_bin
the failure is explained by misplaced zero-context hunks rather than a need for a broader source surface
fixing the existing repo-owned overlay patch in place keeps one canonical descriptor and patch path
the selected touched files remain limited to src/V3Options.h and src/V3Options.cpp
the definition pins contextual anchors for both header members/accessors and C++ notify/parser/registration hunks
parser behavior, upstream regression, docs, compact-shape spelling, sidecar runtime/ABI, execution, timing, arbitrary filelist support, and automatic allocation remain deferred

v3options_h.private_count_fields_anchor: after m_verilateJobs and before compiler-selection fields

v3options_cpp.notify_validation_anchor: inside V3Options::notify() after the --make/--build conflict check and before backend mutual-exclusion checks
v3options_cpp.positive_count_parser_anchor: inside V3Options::parseOptsList() immediately after callStrSetter and before the DECL_OPTION usage comment
v3options_cpp.positive_count_parser_anchor_caveat: the literal insert_after token is only safe when combined with the recorded callStrSetter prior context and parseOptsList() function bounds; a bare '};' anchor is not accepted
